text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minimal losses, suggesting traders are neither panicking nor accumulating aggressively at current levels. The Fear & Greed index at 29 indicates genuine fear sentiment, yet volume at $48B is moderate rather than capitulative, pointing to a cautious hold rather than forced selling. Bitcoin's 56% dominance and broad-based small losses across altcoins signal that risk appetite remains subdued across the market.
